Whether you're sharing with friends or keeping it all to yourself, it's time to XL your taste and experience the joy of caramel like never before. And, of course, it's completely vegan and free from dairy, gluten, eggs, and nuts, so everyone can enjoy this delicious treat.

Non-dairy alternative to milk chocolate with a vegan caramel flavour centre (30%).

*Rainforest Alliance Certified. Find out more at ra.org.
Store in a cool, dry place.

Suitable for people with milk, egg, gluten, peanut and tree nut allergy.
